scope: Read-only pin, participant-access, rubric and calibration verification-gap review; no network, model calls, submitted-code execution, or expected-verdict access

findings.problem: The inspection prompt explicitly requires returning target retained quiescence, but none of the six criteria explicitly requires returning this value. A correctly targeted publication/authority/host/fullGraph result that omits retainedQuiescence can pass the stated rubric.
findings.fix: Add target retained-quiescence output to an existing criterion or a new criterion, and add an omission calibration case; update rubric and integration pins before any live run.

findings.problem: Both composition cases carry the snippet JSDoc claim that distinct names yield distinct input Nodes and resource bindings. C07 therefore contradicts its correct explanation and fails the new name-resource-boundary criterion. The current composition calibration has no unambiguously correct positive control.
findings.fix: Preserve C07 as a contradiction case if intended, and add a separate positive control removing the false JSDoc claim. Do not silently classify contradictory commentary as a fully correct solution.

limits: Static verification only; this does not establish runtime behavior or generalization. Existing material examples are intentionally participant-visible.
